Accuenergy's South African office, based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, represents a global manufacturer of power and energy meters, current transformers and cloud-based energy management software. The company's product range covers power meters, control panels, current transformers, building automation sensors and communication devices for linking meters into a wider monitoring system.

Its cloud-based energy software is used locally for applications including tenant submetering in multi-tenant buildings, EV charging point monitoring, and power quality monitoring for sites needing to track electrical disturbances. The group holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001 and ISO 50001 certification, reflecting a quality and management system built for industrial and commercial energy monitoring. Based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, Accuenergy's South African office serves property managers, facilities teams and electrical contractors needing energy metering and monitoring equipment locally rather than importing directly.

Ace Ends I.T is a software development company based in Theresapark, Pretoria, building custom business systems such as ERP, point-of-sale and HR management platforms for organisations of different sizes and industries. The company also offers web and app development and cloud deployment services, aiming to streamline and integrate a client's processes across every level of the organisation.

Among its in-house products is an invoicing system that lets clients manage their own billing without relying on a generic off-the-shelf package. The company positions itself as a forward-thinking developer with an established history of meeting customer requirements on software built specifically around how a business already works. Based in Theresapark, Pretoria, Ace Ends I.T suits organisations wanting a custom ERP, POS, HR or invoicing system rather than adapting their processes to fit a generic software product.

Active Electronics is an official dealer for Kenwood, Icom, Motorola and Kirisun two-way radios, based in Wierdapark, Centurion, selling and servicing communication equipment for clients in mining, security, logistics, government and other sectors. Beyond standard two-way radios, the company supplies POC radios for countrywide communication over mobile data networks, along with ancillary equipment and high-site and repeater rental for extending radio coverage.

The company also offers electronic design, development and production work, building products to a client's specification rather than only reselling existing equipment. Covering the whole of South Africa and much of Southern Africa, Active Electronics sets up and maintains communications systems of any size, in both digital and analogue formats. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, the company suits organisations across mining, security, logistics and government needing two-way radio equipment, repeater infrastructure or custom electronic design.

Active TV & Video is a Multichoice-accredited installer based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, offering DStv, Xtra View and Single View installations for homes and businesses. Alongside installation work, the business repairs TVs, decoders, microwaves, hi-fis and other household electronics, giving customers a single local shop for both satellite setup and general appliance repairs.

Being Multichoice-accredited means the business meets DStv's own standards for installation quality, which matters for warranty and support purposes on a new decoder or dish installation. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays. Based on Rubida Street in Murrayfield, Pretoria, Active TV & Video suits households needing DStv installation or repairs to their TV, decoder or other electronics from an accredited local installer.

Adams & Adams is a leading African law firm with its head office at Lynnwood Bridge in Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria, housing more than 100 attorneys. The firm's intellectual property practice covers trademark, copyright, design and patent work across the full lifecycle, from acquisition and protection through to enforcement, licensing and commercialisation of IP rights.

Beyond intellectual property, the firm handles corporate and commercial law for public and private companies, private equity firms, financial institutions and government entities, along with dispute resolution in areas including anti-corruption, banking and finance, construction law, family law and personal injury. Further practice areas include competition law, real estate and property law, insurance law, and a dedicated forensics division. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm. Based at Lynnwood Bridge, Pretoria, Adams & Adams suits businesses and individuals across Africa needing intellectual property, corporate, commercial or dispute resolution expertise from a full-service firm.

Advoca Auditing is an accounting and auditing firm based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, founded in 2001 and recognised as a Xero Gold Champion partner. The firm offers auditing and independent reviews focused on understanding a client's unique risks, alongside accounting, taxation, estate planning and administration, payroll administration and business valuations.

Using cloud-based software packages such as Xero, the firm positions its auditing work as more than a report on past events, aiming to flag both growth opportunities and potential stumbling blocks for a client's business. Its tax service covers compliance with South Africa's changing tax legislation alongside value-added tax planning solutions. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, Advoca Auditing suits businesses and individuals needing auditing, tax, estate planning or valuation services delivered on modern, cloud-based accounting platforms.

Afiswitch is a Centurion-based company, part of the EOH Group, that provides South Africa's national automated electronic previous-conviction enquiry service, checking applicants against the SAPS database on behalf of employers and service providers. The company also offers ID and fingerprint verification, alongside broader biometric solutions for organisations needing to confirm a person's identity electronically.

Working through a network of registered service providers, Afiswitch gives background-screening companies and employers a direct, automated link to the national previous-conviction database rather than relying on manual SAPS enquiries. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, Afiswitch suits employers, screening agencies and service providers needing fast, compliant previous-conviction checks or biometric identity verification.

AfTrading supplies advanced drilling fluids, borehole casings and drilling equipment to the mining and construction industries, with branches in South Africa and Botswana based out of Donkerhoek, Pretoria. Its drilling fluids range includes air percussion and mud rotary fluids, bentonite products, defoamers and hammer oils, developed specifically for the demands of borehole and percussion drilling.

The company also supplies drilling hardware such as air percussion tools, drill bits and hammers, along with lithium grease and other lubricants used to keep drilling rigs running. Based in Donkerhoek, Pretoria, AfTrading suits mining and construction companies across South Africa and Botswana needing drilling fluids and equipment from a specialist supplier rather than a general industrial distributor.

Agile Bridge is a software development firm based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, specialising in custom software for enterprise and business applications, mobile app development and team capacity augmentation. Its augmentation service places developers with skills in AI/ML, cloud architecture and DevOps directly into a client's existing team, rather than only delivering a separate standalone project.

The company describes its developers as craftsmen rather than coders, built around continuous learning and a close working relationship with clients to fully understand their business needs before writing code. Its values emphasise mutual respect, admitting and learning from mistakes, and contributing to team deliverables rather than working in isolation. Based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, Agile Bridge suits medium and large corporate and enterprise clients needing custom software, mobile apps or extra development capacity with specialist AI, cloud or DevOps skills.

Aguazoi, formerly known as Agua e Vida, purifies water through a seven-step process at its Raslouw Corner Mall location in Centurion, then reintroduces electrolytes and essential minerals that standard purification removes. The company raises the water's pH for alkalinity and describes an energising and restructuring step aimed at improving cellular absorption, going beyond a typical single-stage filtration process.

Beyond its retail water shop, Aguazoi offers bottled water distribution, water dispenser rental, bulk water supply and installation of home and commercial filtration systems, alongside water-industry consulting for businesses setting up their own water treatment. Based in Raslouw, Centurion, Aguazoi suits households and businesses wanting remineralised, alkaline purified water rather than standard reverse-osmosis water stripped of minerals.

Alberts Advisory is an accounting and tax advisory firm based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, led by a CIMA-qualified chartered accountant and a SAIPA-registered professional accountant. Its accounting and compliance services cover monthly bookkeeping, management accounts, financial statements, VAT returns, payroll processing and CIPC compliance for close corporations and companies.

On the tax side, the firm handles company income tax, provisional tax, individual tax returns, SARS registrations and tax planning, while its advisory services extend to cash flow forecasting, budgeting, business performance analysis and systems and process improvement. The firm positions itself around precise, detail-driven work that turns financial information into insight for long-term decision-making rather than compliance alone. It is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 4pm, closed weekends. Based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, Alberts Advisory suits businesses wanting accounting, tax and strategic financial advisory handled by one qualified practice.

ALNEL Construction is a Black-owned company with more than 10 years of experience building towers and masts for the communications, security and power industries, based in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria. The company provides a complete turnkey solution covering site surveying, access-road and foundation construction, and the supply, installation and maintenance of lattice towers and masts across South Africa and beyond its borders.

Its range covers guyed lattice towers, three-leg and four-leg self-support towers, monopole towers and rooftop towers, all built from high-tensile, hot-dip galvanised materials engineered for a site's specific location and loading requirements. ALNEL also handles complete site building, including power and palisade fence installation and equipment room construction, and trains its technicians in risk assessment, firefighting, first aid, rigging and working at heights. Based in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria, ALNEL Construction suits telecommunications, security and power companies needing towers designed, built and maintained end-to-end.

Aluminium Flanges is a Derdepoort-based supplier of locally made flanges, galvanised fittings and cut-to-length pipes for DIY furniture and decor projects, trading since 2016. Its collections include industrial desk and shelving systems, modular wardrobe systems, barn-door sliding hardware, library ladder kits and bathroom accessories, built from industrial pipe and fitting components rather than standard flat-pack furniture parts.

Every order is manufactured to fit a customer's own space and delivered anywhere in South Africa, and the company offers an online AI room visualiser so customers can preview custom shelving or desks before ordering. Custom work is also available for designers, shop owners and weekend DIY enthusiasts with a specific vision in mind. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, Aluminium Flanges suits DIY enthusiasts and small businesses wanting industrial-look furniture components built to their own specification.

Alura Pharmaceuticals, based in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, manufactures and distributes natural and herbal healthcare products including Herbal Iceman, Femoxil and Comfrey Complex. Its original Iceman range is a topical cooling gel developed for horses, relieving pain from arthritis and muscle, tendon and joint injuries, while Herbal Iceman adapts the same arnica-based cooling gel for human use in athletes and the elderly.

The company's wider range includes Flux-O, Presto Gel and a Laringo herbal throat spray, alongside its separate API business, which holds SAHPRA certification to import and distribute scheduled active pharmaceutical ingredients. Based in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, Alura Pharmaceuticals suits pharmacies, equestrian suppliers and healthcare businesses needing natural and herbal products, as well as companies requiring certified scheduled API import and distribution.

Amber2Green is a fleet management and transport company based in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, offering passenger transport solutions from simple point-to-point trips through to personal chauffeur services and specialised event transport. The company also provides roadside assistance and bus hire for larger group transport needs.

Its VEBI digital system replaces paper-based fleet checking methods with step-by-step digital procedures, letting drivers log information via a smart device that updates managers in real time and eliminates the human error that comes with manual paper logs. The system also supports general reporting and more technical fleet analysis over time. Based in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, Amber2Green suits businesses needing chauffeur or event transport services as well as fleet operators wanting a digital system to monitor and manage their vehicles.

Amberjade Concepts and Designing is a family-run creative agency based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, founded in 2006 and offering website design, e-commerce development, branding and UI/UX design for small businesses and agencies across South Africa. The agency positions its work around building sites and systems that keep working after launch, avoiding the overcomplicated plugins and unexplained jargon that can leave a small business stuck with a site nobody can maintain.

Alongside web design, the agency offers a lead-tracking service that automatically follows up on missed calls and keeps every contact and conversation in one place, addressing a gap many business owners never get around to fixing until it starts costing them customers. Its social media service covers both content and scheduling. Based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, Amberjade suits small businesses wanting a website, branding and lead-tracking system built by a team that sticks around after the project is delivered.

Angelcy Brand Messengers is a Pretoria brand communications, marketing and advertising agency and consultancy, describing itself as an international specialist in the field. Its services run from strategic marketing consulting and brand and marketing plan development through market research and benchmarking to advertising and content development, campaign planning and media buying, PR and event management. Creative work covers print, outdoor, web and digital, video and animation, packaging and exhibition design.

Founded in 2005 and privately held, the agency has worked with organisations across a wide range of industries, from smaller businesses to large multinationals, and lists clients in South Africa, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, Namibia, Nigeria, Botswana, the USA and Mauritius. Based at 673a Keeshond Street in Garsfontein, Pretoria, Angelcy suits organisations that want their marketing and brand strategy aligned with their wider business goals, with the right media and channels chosen to reach their target audiences.

Aon South Africa - Pretoria is the Waterkloof Glen branch of Aon, a global risk and insurance broker with 50,000 colleagues across 120 countries. The branch offers risk management, insurance broking, and retirement, investment and human capital solutions to both organisations and individuals in the Pretoria area.

Its personal solutions cover household and motor insurance, including cover tailored for electric vehicles, which carry a different risk profile from high-voltage systems and battery technology to specialised repair costs. On the corporate side, Aon draws on its global data and analytics capability to help businesses reduce volatility and improve performance, backed by the wider Aon United network of specialists worldwide. Based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, Aon South Africa suits individuals needing personal insurance as well as organisations needing risk management, broking or human capital advice from a global insurance group with local representation.

Arrie Nel Groothandelaar is the wholesale distribution arm of the Arrie Nel Pharmacy Group, based in Villieria, Pretoria, established in 2003 to centralise buying and secure better pricing across the group's pharmacies. The wider group's journey began in 2000 with the consolidation of three pharmacies and has since grown to more than 130 pharmacies nationally.

In 2021, the group expanded further by acquiring the Mopani Pharmacy Group, which dates back to 1982, along with Thrive Pharmacies, and strengthened its national presence by taking a majority shareholding in Pharmed, a separate pharmaceutical wholesaler. The group describes "Family First" as its core value across all its pharmacy operations. It is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 4pm. Based in Villieria, Pretoria, Arrie Nel Groothandelaar suits pharmacies within the Arrie Nel Group needing centralised, better-priced wholesale buying rather than negotiating individually with suppliers.

Arrow Signs is a signage manufacturer based in Hennopspark, Centurion, designing and producing vinyl, aluminium, promotional and safety signage for businesses, government departments, organisations and individuals. Its range covers computer-cut vinyl, screen printing, aluminium labels, laser-cut lettering, and traffic and safety signs, manufactured in-house at its own factory.

The company's installation teams fit signs according to each client's specific requirements, covering the full process from design and manufacture through to on-site installation. Having grown into a respected signage manufacturer serving businesses across Centurion, Pretoria and the greater Johannesburg area, Arrow Signs positions itself as a committed long-term business partner rather than a once-off supplier. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, the company suits businesses and organisations needing signage designed, manufactured and installed by one supplier.

Artisan Coffee is a budget-friendly coffee bar and restaurant based in the Aula, also known as Rautenbach Hall, on the University of Pretoria's Hatfield Campus. The venue caters to a student clientele with vegetarian, vegan, keto and halal menu options alongside its standard coffee and food offering.

Being located directly on campus gives students and staff a convenient option between lectures, with dine-in, takeaway and delivery all available rather than requiring a trip off campus. Based at the University of Pretoria's Hatfield Campus, Artisan Coffee suits students and staff looking for an affordable coffee bar with dietary options to suit vegetarian, vegan, keto and halal diets.

Asparagus Glen Freight is an asset-based trucking company based in Sterrewag, Pretoria, offering partial, less-than and full truckload freight services across Southern Africa. Its specialised carriers handle bulk transport of both liquid and particulate commodities, as well as heavy hauls that need dedicated equipment rather than a standard trailer.

The company also provides compliant, secure transport of hazardous liquids and chemical compounds, a service that requires specific certification and handling procedures beyond general freight work. Owning its own fleet rather than brokering loads to third parties, the company positions itself around reliability and dependable delivery timelines built on values including integrity and honesty. Based in Sterrewag, Pretoria, Asparagus Glen Freight suits businesses needing general, bulk or hazardous liquid freight transported by an asset-based carrier across the region.

Assured Networks is an independent ICT consulting company based in Wierdapark, Centurion, founded by engineers with a combined 40 years of experience. The company focuses purely on the ICT niche, offering vendor-neutral technology solutions across cybersecurity, unified network solutions, digital services and IT equipment sales for mining, transport, telecoms, government and private-sector clients.

Its project experience spans the complete technology life cycle, from designing and directing projects through to network operations, maintenance and hardware support, and includes work on RF links, fibre-to-the-home, VSAT and MPLS networks among some of the largest projects of their kind. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, Assured Networks suits organisations needing vendor-neutral ICT consulting and network infrastructure work handled by engineers with deep field experience rather than a reseller tied to one brand.

ATK Signs has been Pretoria North's signage company since January 2002, designing, manufacturing and installing corporate signage, shopfront signs, illuminated signs, pylons and billboards for businesses across Pretoria, Midrand and Johannesburg. The company handles every step in-house, with its own graphic designers, qualified sign tradespeople and professional installers working under one roof from first consultation through to final installation.

Its production capability includes large-format and flatbed printing, CNC routing, laser cutting and 3D fabrication, alongside LED lightboxes, neon signs, channel letters and backlit panels for illuminated signage. All installers hold valid working-at-heights credentials under the Occupational Health and Safety Act, and the company operates under a SHEQ-compliant safety, health, environment and quality system. Based in Pretoria North, ATK Signs suits businesses needing signage designed, fabricated and installed to a high safety and quality standard by one in-house team.

Bakers Bin is a wholesale bakery-supplies retailer founded in Pretoria in 1999, distributing baking ingredients, easy-to-follow pre-mixes, decorations and equipment to bakeries, restaurants, cafes and home bakers, with this branch trading from Die Wilgers, Pretoria. The range covers everything from basic baking ingredients through to kids' party accessories, sweets, custom icing sugar prints and imported specialist baking utensils.

Having grown from its Pretoria origins into a national franchise, Bakers Bin aims to cover a baker's full circle of needs, from packaging through to cleaning products, available in one location rather than across several different suppliers. The business sells directly to the public at its various shops while also supplying bulk wholesale orders to commercial bakers and caterers. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, Bakers Bin suits home bakers and professional kitchens needing baking ingredients, equipment and decorations from a specialist supplier rather than a general supermarket aisle.

Baraka Beef is an online butchery based in The Willows, Pretoria, supplying beef, chicken, pork, lamb and fish to restaurants and the catering trade as well as direct to consumers. Having spent years supplying the finest cuts to restaurants, the business developed a consumer-facing portal so home customers can order the same quality of meat that restaurants already receive.

Its range includes thick-cut steaks, mixed-cut burger patties, chicken sosaties, lamb loin chops and deboned pork belly, with orders delivered by refrigerated truck across Gauteng, Klerksdorp and Potchefstroom, typically the next day. After placing an order, customers get a call from a consultant to personalise their selection before delivery. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, Baraka Beef suits households wanting restaurant-quality meat delivered to their door, as well as restaurants and caterers needing a reliable wholesale meat supplier.

Basadzi Media & Personnel is a media, communications and staffing agency based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, offering integrated marketing campaigns, branding and social media management alongside recruitment and broader human capital solutions. The agency brings 18 years of experience to its combined media and staffing offering, giving it a dual focus not many single-service agencies can match.

Clients have praised the agency for delivering reliable, flexible and speedy production of quality adverts under multi-year service contracts, including government clients such as research and space agencies. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, Basadzi Media & Personnel suits organisations needing advertising and media production handled alongside recruitment and staffing, rather than engaging a separate agency and recruiter for each function.

Batsetla Construction is a construction and civil engineering company based in Pretoria North, delivering asphalt road surfacing, building works and road maintenance to public and private sector clients. Its road division covers car parks, motorways, asphalt surfacing and repairs, footpaths and cycleways, and road markings and signage, with recent projects including road works and slurry seal work in Secunda, Klipgat and Makhado.

On the building side, the company handles general building, extensions and alterations, renovations and maintenance, plumbing including drainage and geyser installation, and roofing work covering flat and pitched roofs, waterproofing and damp-proofing. Further services include ceiling installation, painting, paving and kerbing, and flooring and tile fitting. Based in Pretoria North, Batsetla Construction suits government bodies and private clients needing both civil road infrastructure and general building and renovation work from a single contractor.

Baxolog Home Builders is an NHBRC-registered residential construction company based on Cunningham Avenue in Waverley, Pretoria, established in 2012. The family-led business offers turnkey home-building packages that take a project from architectural plans and council approval through construction, finishes and handover, with building costs starting from R9,650 per square metre.

Beyond new home construction, Baxolog also handles home renovations, alterations and extensions, serving clients across Pretoria, Centurion and Hartbeespoort. The business draws on decades of combined construction experience among its team, applying that background to both full turnkey builds and smaller renovation projects. Based in Waverley, Pretoria, Baxolog Home Builders suits clients wanting an NHBRC-registered builder to manage a new home build or renovation from planning through to completion.

Bearing Net is an industrial supplier based in Silverton, Pretoria, stocking bearings, power transmission components, gearboxes, electric motors, sealing products and conveyor belts since 2001. The company also manufactures custom hydraulic seals and supplies V and timing belt pulleys and sprockets for the engineering, automotive, plastics and heavy earth-moving industries.

Its supply chain draws on established overseas and South African bearing and transmission manufacturers, with all products built to international ISO 9001 quality standards. Items not held in stock are typically procured and delivered within one day, backed by round-the-clock service aimed at fast turnaround times. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to midday, closed Sundays. Based in Salieshoek, Silverton, Bearing Net suits engineering, automotive, plastics and heavy-machinery businesses needing bearings, gearboxes or custom seals from an established industrial supplier.

Bed and Couch Rosslyn, on the corner of the R566 and Toermalyn Street in Klerksoord, Akasia, sells orthopedic beds, couches, pedestals, headboards and lounge suites. Its range includes memory foam and spring base sets in different weight ratings and bed sizes, along with recliner chairs and multi-piece lounge suites in various fabric and finish options.

The store offers delivery, setup and monthly instalment credit options, making larger furniture purchases more manageable for customers who don't want to pay the full amount upfront. Based in Klerksoord, Akasia, Bed and Couch Rosslyn suits households in the wider Rosslyn and Akasia area needing orthopedic bedroom and lounge furniture with delivery and flexible payment options.

Best Plumbers Pretoria, based on Sefako Makgatho Drive in Sinoville, handles emergency and scheduled plumbing work including burst geysers, leaking pipes, blocked drains, and faulty taps and toilets, available for 24-hour emergency call-outs. The business also takes on new installations, bathroom renovations and drain rerouting for customers planning rather than reacting to a plumbing problem.

All of its plumbers are certified and qualified, and the business is insurance-approved, which matters when a plumbing claim needs to go through a client's household or business insurance policy. Serving both residential and commercial clients, the company aims to retain client loyalty through consistent, reliable service rather than one-off emergency call-outs alone. Based in Sinoville, Pretoria, Best Plumbers Pretoria suits homeowners and businesses needing both urgent emergency plumbing and planned installation or renovation work from an insurance-approved provider.

Binary Bit Technologies is a 100% Black-owned ICT company based in Karenpark, Pretoria, offering web development, mobile apps, cloud solutions, cybersecurity and AI services tailored specifically for informal, micro and medium-sized businesses. The company also provides IT support and maintenance, software development, multimedia design, robotics and project management services.

Its stated focus is on serving informal traders, SMEs, stokvels and government institutions, groups that often get overlooked by larger ICT providers built around corporate clients. The company's core values centre on excellence, integrity, innovation and collaboration, aiming to deliver reliable, scalable IT solutions rather than one-size-fits-all packages. Based in Karenpark, Pretoria, Binary Bit Technologies suits informal traders, small businesses, stokvels and government institutions needing web, mobile, cloud or AI solutions built around their specific scale and budget.

Bind-X (Pty) Ltd, based at Samrand Business Park in Louwlardia, Centurion, develops the Terrabind biological dust-control product used on mining haul roads to reduce both water usage and airborne dust. The product is designed to bind dust into a more solid road surface, cutting down the water trucks would otherwise need to use for dust suppression.

The company positions its work around responsible mining, helping operations reduce their environmental footprint while improving haul-road safety and durability. With facilities in South Africa, Australia and Europe, Bind-X supports mining operations across multiple continents from a shared product and research base. Based in Louwlardia, Centurion, Bind-X suits mining companies needing a biological dust-control solution for haul roads rather than relying solely on water-based dust suppression.

Blignaut BlueStar is a Sanlam-authorised financial advisory practice based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, established in 1988 and recognised as one of Sanlam's Top Advisers for 18 years. The practice includes a Certified Financial Planner, offering financial planning, retirement and estate planning, investments, short-term insurance and tax services.

Its product range covers gap cover, health and medical aid solutions, disability, cancer and severe illness cover, and income protection, alongside standard short-term insurance such as household and motor cover. Built on a foundation the practice describes as integrity, respect, trust and lasting relationships, the team works with both individuals and businesses pursuing sustainable, long-term wealth. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, Blignaut BlueStar suits individuals and businesses needing comprehensive financial planning, insurance and investment advice from an established Sanlam-authorised practice.

Blue Point Technologies, operating since 2016, is a technology company based in Waverley, Pretoria, with a team drawing on more than 25 years of combined engineering experience across electronic design and development, custom software, precision instrumentation and turnkey automation. The company is organised into three divisions: Blue Point Electronics, Blue Point Energies and Blue Point Software.

Blue Point Software delivers tailored software solutions for industries including manufacturing, finance and healthcare, focused on customer needs and timely delivery, while the electronics and energy divisions handle hardware design and energy-related automation projects. The company's process runs through consultation, where consultants visit the client to assess their needs, installation suited to projects of any size, and after-sale support available by phone. Based in Waverley, Pretoria, Blue Point Technologies suits businesses needing electronic design, custom software or automation engineered around a specific operational challenge.

Blue Sky Projects, based in La Montagne, Pretoria, was established in 1993 as a maintenance business in the Pierre van Ryneveld area of Centurion before registering as a company in 2004 to take on larger contracts. The business builds new houses and factories, and installs boundary walls, roofing, steel gates and burglar bars, CCTV, intercoms and electrical systems.

Its services extend to paving, painting, ceilings and tiling, along with palisade fencing, wooden roofs and decks, and gate motor installation and maintenance. Since registering, the company has expanded beyond Pretoria to take on projects in Johannesburg, Polokwane, Bela-Bela, Brits, Emalahleni, Rustenburg and Nelspruit. Based in La Montagne, Pretoria, Blue Sky Projects suits clients across several provinces needing new construction, security installations or general building maintenance from one established contractor.

Bluecrystal Properties is a property sales and rental agency based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, with 17 years of experience serving clients primarily across Centurion and Pretoria. The agency handles residential, commercial and agricultural property, covering everything from apartments and houses through to farms and smallholdings.

Its online tools include a bond calculator and free property valuations, giving prospective buyers and sellers a starting point before engaging an agent directly. While based in Eldoraigne, Bluecrystal Properties has also handled listings for clients as far afield as the coast, extending its reach beyond its core Centurion and Pretoria market. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, Bluecrystal Properties suits buyers and sellers across residential, commercial and agricultural property looking for an experienced, locally based agency.

Boardwalk Lakeside is a retail park within the Boardwalk precinct in Pretoria East, offering customisable retail spaces from 120 square metres at rates from R135 per square metre. The park sits within the wider Boardwalk Office Park, giving retail tenants high visibility and foot traffic from the office workers and visitors already in the precinct.

Tenants include restaurants overlooking a dam, a Virgin Active gym, and other retailers across landscaped common areas with ample parking for both staff and customers. The flexible, customisable spaces let businesses design a shopfront to suit their own retail concept rather than fitting into a rigid standard unit. Based in Boardwalk Manor, Pretoria East, Boardwalk Lakeside suits retailers and restaurant operators looking for a prominent, high-footfall retail space within an established business precinct.

Bodibe Ba Thaba is an investment and consulting company based in Philip Nel Park, Pretoria, focused on food franchising, fashion retail, property development and business consulting. The company offers capital raising support for entrepreneurs and businesses needing funding, alongside strategic planning services for organisations setting direction across these sectors.

Its entrepreneurial development support is aimed at helping new and growing businesses build the operational and strategic foundations needed to secure investment and scale. It is open Monday to Saturday from 10am to 7:30pm. Based in Philip Nel Park, Pretoria, Bodibe Ba Thaba suits entrepreneurs and businesses in food franchising, fashion retail or property development needing capital raising, strategic planning or consulting support.

Boma Meat Market is a butchery inside Olympus Village Shopping Centre, Pretoria, part of an established Pretoria East meat-market brand tracing its roots to 1994. The shop stocks biltong, dry wors, vacuum-packed steaks and prepared meals, alongside dedicated ranges for beef, chicken, lamb, pork, mince and patties, sosaties and cold meats.

Describing itself as one of South Africa's most awarded butcher shops, the business also offers home delivery, letting customers order braai packs, bulk packs and ready-made meals without visiting the store in person. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturdays from 8am to 5pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm. Based in Olympus, Pretoria, Boma Meat Market suits households and braai hosts across Pretoria East wanting a wide butchery range with the option of home delivery.

Boshoff Physiotherapy is a physiotherapy practice in Montana, Pretoria, treating back and neck pain, tension headaches, TMJ jaw pain and sports injuries, alongside women's health conditions including pelvic floor issues and post-operative rehabilitation. Its physiotherapist qualified at the University of Pretoria and completed further certification in orthopaedic manipulative therapy as well as specific training in women's health physiotherapy.

Treatment methods include dry needling, soft tissue massage, manual joint mobilisation, strapping, rehabilitation exercises and ultrasound and TENS therapy, delivered over 45-minute sessions. The practice forms part of a wider franchise network with branches across Gauteng, the Western Cape, Mpumalanga and the Eastern Cape. Based in Montana, Pretoria, Boshoff Physiotherapy suits patients needing treatment for back and neck pain, sports injuries, chronic pain or women's health conditions from a qualified physiotherapist.

Botha & Lovegrove Inc is a law firm based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, practising since 2006 and made up mainly of women lawyers providing legal services to individuals, foreign nationals, associations, and private and public companies. The firm specialises in conveyancing, contracts, commercial law, deceased estates and estate planning, as well as property law and High Court litigation.

Its client base includes institutional and corporate clients drawing on the firm's recognised expertise, combining transactional work with dispute-resolution skills across different legal fields. The firm invests in regular seminars and staff training to keep its legal knowledge current. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, Botha & Lovegrove Inc suits individuals, foreign nationals and corporate clients needing conveyancing, commercial law or estate planning handled by an established, women-led firm.
